mechanism.claim: An extreme seven-day improvement or deterioration in the official SF Fed Daily News Sentiment Index identifies persistent macro risk sentiment. After a conservative weekly-publication embargo and during elevated BTC variation, follow the sentiment-change direction for one day.
mechanism.side: strict sign of completed seven-calendar-day news sentiment change
mechanism.why_distinct: EPU measures uncertainty magnitude and GPR measures geopolitical threats/acts. HVNSR uses the signed tone of broad U.S. economic news from an official independently constructed index; no repository alpha uses this source.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: news sentiment predicts future economic conditions and the candidate separately requires causal elevated BTC variation
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: a conservatively delayed official macro-news tone clock is absent from Gross9

features.source: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco Daily News Sentiment Index XLSX
features.observation: finite official daily news sentiment for calendar day D; higher is more positive
features.availability: D+8 00:00 UTC, deliberately later than any weekly update covering D; no earlier use
features.sentiment_change: sentiment[D]-sentiment[D-7 calendar days], requiring both exact observations; strict nonzero
features.sentiment_shock_rank: strict-prior midrank of abs(sentiment_change) over at most 270 valid changes, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.btc_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact completed 5m BTC log returns over UTC day D+7, ending at decision)
features.btc_variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.reservation: daily nonoverlapping; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

definitions.no_sentiment_tail: sentiment direction and BTC variation without shock rank
definitions.one_week_stale_sentiment: prior seven-day sentiment change with current BTC variation

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.paper: Measuring News Sentiment, Journal of Econometrics 228(2), 2022
research_boundary.selection_basis: independent official signed macro-news sentiment mechanism

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no source, delay, change horizon, rank, variation, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
